subject: Clarifying SOC 2 report origination and reissue status
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@medtechsolutions.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest SOC 2 and provenance of past reports

Hi Logan,

We're finalizing our vendor acceptance for Redwood and I ran into something odd in the files the procurement portal provided. The package includes a file named "SOC2_2025_final.pdf" and another labeled "SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf" — our security team is unclear whether one is a reissue, a replacement, or an archived copy. Can you confirm which document is the authoritative Type II for the 2026 audit window and whether any reissues or bridges exist that we should accept for coverage into 2027?

Specifically they asked for:
- Auditor name and report ID used for the Type II
- Whether any reissue changed the report ID or coverage dates
- If there is an official bridge letter that extends coverage beyond the audit window, and its effective dates

Our deadline for completing the security review is next Friday; if you can send the latest attestation + any explanatory note on provenance that would be great.

Attachment: MedTech_RFP.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Vendor Risk Lead
MedTech Solutions
obarnes@medtechsolutions.com

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@medtechsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest SOC 2 and provenance of past reports

Hi Olivia — thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the confusion. Quick answers up front, and we'll follow with formal artifacts:

- Authoritative Type II for the 2026 audit window: Redwood SOC 2 Type II (period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31).
- Auditor: Morrison & Flynn LLP.
- Reissue: there was a technical reissue in Feb 2027 to correct a cover page metadata field; the underlying testing period and report ID remained the same.
- Bridge: we can provide a bridge letter that attests continuous controls from 2027-01-01 through 2027-05-31 (if you need a different end date tell us).

What I need from you: do you require the reissued PDF (with the corrected metadata) or will the original file labeled "SOC2_2025_final.pdf" be acceptable if accompanied by a short provenance note? Some customers want the reissued PDF for their repository; others accept a bridge + attestation statement.

I'll attach our standard reissued Type II PDF and a draft bridge letter after I confirm with Marissa/Neha here — copying them in case you need signed/escrowed versions or the auditor contact for direct verification.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
Attachment: (will attach Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_reissue.pdf, Bridge_Letter_May2027.pdf)

From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@medtechsolutions.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, security@medtechsolutions.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest SOC 2 and provenance of past reports

Thanks, Logan.

For procurement we need: the reissued PDF (so our records match), the bridge letter covering at least through end of May 2027, and a one-paragraph provenance statement our security reviewer can paste into the vendor intake form that includes the auditor name and the report ID.

If the reissued file has the same report ID as the earlier file, please explicitly state that in the provenance sentence. If there is a signed auditor contact (email or phone) in case our team needs to verify, include that as well.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we can mark this as complete as soon as we receive the three items.

Best,
Olivia

Hi Olivia — Marissa here from Security & Compliance. Apologies for the metadata confusion; here's the definitive record and what we'll attach for your intake: 

1) Authoritative attestation: "Redwood SOC 2 Type II" — testing period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
2) Auditor: Morrison & Flynn LLP.
3) Report ID: RF-2026-SOC2-T2-0419 (this is the canonical identifier used by the auditor).
4) Reissue note: The PDF initially published to the portal (file name "SOC2_2025_final.pdf") contained an incorrect cover metadata tag that mis-stated the label. We issued a corrected PDF on 2027-02-14; the correction did not change the testing period, auditor conclusions, or the report ID. In short: same report ID, corrected cover metadata only.
5) Bridge letter: attached. Effective coverage in the bridge is 2027-01-01 through 2027-05-31. If you need coverage through a later date we can prepare an updated bridge or provide a signed attestation from our auditor subject to their availability.

Attachments included in this email: 
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_reissue.pdf (PDF, 2.1 MB)
